text: No fire was detected on this rural property (ASSET-F08) between October 4 and November 3, 2026. Satellite sensors (VIIRS and MODIS) monitored the area daily during this period, but no thermal anomalies were recorded within the asset’s boundaries. While this rules out significant fires, small or short-lived fires obscured by clouds may not have been detected. The assessment does not confirm the absence of burned areas or the cause of any potential changes. Observations were sourced from NASA FIRMS, with full sensor coverage confirmed for the evaluated period.
